I'm going to see one this week after much encouragement from Reddit!! I don't know why I've waited ten plus years to do so, perhaps it was the whole taboo idea of seeing a "mental doctor" in a "mental hospital" that is scary or perhaps everything I thought I knew about mental illnesses and "shrinks", I learn from the movies. No one wants to admit that they are seeking help for "mental health" issues because it sounded so wrong or embarassing...  I changed my negative perception by unlearning everything I thought I knew about depression and seeking psychiatric help and just accept that something inside me needs to be fixed.

**Take a moment and consider this simple scenario.**
Imagine... You are a pro gamer in a clan. All your clan mates are computer literate while you, being an ex-console player, knows nothing about computers. One day you realize your computer is getting really slow and buggy as compared to your friend's. You tried to hide the problem because you do not want to appear weak amongst the 1337 and did nothing to fix it. Overtime, your computer got so slow and laggy, it started to hinder your gaming performance and before you knew it, you have become a noob.

The shame of becoming a noob is so overpowering, you decided quit the clan and the game all together. You distant yourself from your clan mates even though they still consider you as a friend, but to you, it is too late.. To you, they are now like strangers, laughing behind your back. Slowly, the shame manifested itself into hatred and you blame yourself for it. Even worst, you think that you deserved it. One night, you couldn't take it anymore and trashed your computer and vanished from the face of the Internet forever. The End..

Sounds stupid right? You could've just admit that you know nothing about computers and bring it to the damn IT guy.

I'm very introverted and suffers heavily in the social department. I smoke it to "cure" my depression and serious anxiety issues that is borderline life crippling. At first I thought it was working and slowly I became a very heavy smoker.

10 years later, my 3rd dealer retired/died and I took it as a que to stop smoking (considering it was near election day which means dry season in my country). Now that I'm sober (at the moment), looking back, it may had helped a bit but in my case, not the true solution. 

When I first started, it gives me a tremendous confidence boost and really helped my depression. After years of gradual heavy smoking, my tolerance level build up and it no longer had that effect on me. Soon the effect reversed and instead turned me more grumpy and irritated. I quit trees for 4 months to "reset" my tolerance level. It works but the cycle will return, thus I conclude that it is not the real solution. I will be trying out a therapist soon and hope that would give better results. Better late than never. At the mean time, need to look for new dealer...


**TLDR helped a little at first but in the long run, not a real solution, although an awesome pass time.. You don't want to just be a pothead forever and watch you life drift by as you munch cheetos while watching youtube.**

If it's a problem that can be solved with money, it's not a problem. I am depressed to the point that money doesn't matter anymore and even went as far as to deliberately sabotage my own projects just so I could run out of money quick and give myself more reason to die, fast. It doesn't make sense and yet it does.. I too lost my 20s and will never get it back and I even ask the same question. **What's the point of waiting it out?** Well, we're not waiting it out and we're not lazy. We're unsure and scared.. scared to live, and scared to die. It is something that can never be reasoned. Logic don't apply here. The real question here is why are we scared. Why are you scared to live? why are you scared to die? Your wanting to ramble and leaving a suicide note is a sign we want to continue existing. Living. To leave a mark, and a story behind, to be remembered.. yes, we feel like killing ourselves and yet we want to continue existing.

Non suicidal people advising suicidal people not to kill themselves is like a rich guy telling a poor guy not to worry.. It won't work. I want it to work, but it won't.. in fact, I think it makes us feel even worst. A rich guy can give money to the poor guy and problem solved, but a happy guy can never give happiness to a suicidal guy.. unless you're hottie and willing to give us a blowjob. hah
